protocol.annotation_policy:
T08 completion001: four existing full-source families, no new-family count.
Use gpt-6-astra at ultra as explicitly authorized. Read repository contracts, CODEBOOK-v1, AUTHOR_GUIDE and AUTHOR_ADDENDUM_V2. Scope is exact four named input/admission rows, after all source and parent hash checks. Existing acceptance is evidence, not authority for new musical conclusions.
Individually read the entire selected primary score/canonical source and all inherited target layers, keeping exact timing, analytical voice distinct from part/notation voice, source facts distinct from model interpretation. Audit correspondence, ties/repeats and complete selected-version extent before semantic additions.
Focus first on explicit unresolved rows in existing coverage metadata, while correcting any inherited defect found. Never mark unknown as absence or not-applicable to satisfy the quota. Every new supported target/absence/not-applicability needs musical, addressed rationale and evidence. Full required coverage may remain impossible; report it honestly. A claimed complete view requires substantive source-grounded decisions across every required layer under unchanged current profile.
Actual departure creates, held dependency maintains, actual arrival releases; preparation is not creation, and post-arrival overlap is not a continuing dependency by itself. No bulk role labels from membership/register or source part. Where several readings are supported, retain explicit bounded interpretation/alternatives and provenance; do not invent certainty.
Write each author attempt in fresh authors/<agent>/<safe>/attemptNNN, retaining original terminal files unchanged. Existing author/imported scripts must never be executed; independently author your own decisions/helpers, using approved unchanged repository writer APIs. Reuse tested repository contracts without silently installing dependencies. Keep failed attempts and diagnostics.
Freeze source-reading receipts, decisions, bundle, assessment-v2, coverage and evidence manifest before independent review. Author cannot accept own work. Independent reviewer binds exact bundle/assessment/profile fingerprints, actually checks relevant primary musical material and all changes, retains attribution of any inherited review, and challenges completeness. Fresh target corrections require fresh linked author attempts.
Training, neural architecture, GPU runs, TEST/VALIDATION payloads, publication, commits and legacy are out of scope. Root alone updates experiment lifecycle/ledger/STATUS and assembles final releases. No claim of human gold. Tokens/backend/cost remain null unless actual telemetry is supplied.
